justice: Spatial resources appear generously allocated across the corridor, with broad carriageway space, planted verges, and sidewalks visible on both sides rather than only serving one user group.

The street provides parallel pedestrian space on both sides through continuous side paths under the trees, which suggests a relatively fair distribution of access for people approaching from either direction.

Accessibility is only moderate because no curb ramps, tactile paving, marked crossings, or other barrier-free crossing details are visible in the image, so inclusive movement across the road cannot be confirmed.

The sidewalks look physically separated from moving traffic by curbs and planting strips, which supports equitable access for non-motorized users, but the very wide roadway still prioritizes motor traffic in overall space allocation.
